reviewedMechanism: Message code-unit length plus 7 is checked before UTF-8 byte count plus 7, interpolation and diagnostic encoding.
Only Budget.check failures enter the emergency writer; writeBytes is outside that inner try, so its rejection is not retried.
Stdout write is outside the diagnostic catch; even quota-shaped and falsy sink rejections propagate.
Caller abort is checked before diagnostic work, and writeBytes receives the supplied signal.
withRegexSession and its cleanup/caller precedence contract are unchanged.
Expr index adds no regular expression execution, package dependency or public export; matching stays in existing worker-backed session.matchExpr.
limit: Static inspection of index-only patch and critical files plus runtime import/worker instrumentation. Not a general sandbox proof, deployed-service/full-suite acceptance, or validation of unrelated HTML changes.
